Measure browser DNS/TLS/TTFB/download/render and API p50/p95/p99; distinguish bandwidth from round-trip latency.

Profile event loop and CPU; use workers or multiple instances only after testing shared state and database capacity.
Source review cannot confirm backups, restores, recovery objectives or high availability.
Use encrypted offsite backups, restoration drills, monitoring and documented RPO/RTO; avoid assuming a single VM is highly available.
